description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the Membership API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a custom EndpointIntegrationTestCase and includes tests for retrieving all memberships, retrieving one membership, creating, updating, and deleting memberships, using data providers to supply test cases from an external YAML file.

classes.name: MembershipAPITest
classes.description: A test class for API endpoints related to Membership management, using PHPUnit. It covers CRUD operations with data providers, leveraging mock services and external YAML test case configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables and populating fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all membership records via the API using data from the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method, sourcing from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single membership record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetOne' method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new membership record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testCreate' method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing membership record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testUpdate' method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a membership record via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testDelete' method.
